accept.reason: Reframes noisy-label learning as data condensation, sidestepping the detect-then-correct vicious cycle; disclosed transfer from dataset distillation
Covers three DD families (DATM, DANCE, RCIG) under symmetric, asymmetric and natural noise on CIFAR-10/100, Tiny-ImageNet, CIFAR-10N/100N
Under heavy symmetric noise one distilled image per class beats training on the full noisy set
Honest negative result: structured asymmetric noise is absorbed into the distilled set, qualifying the thesis
Tests real human-annotation noise (CIFAR-10N/100N) and reports the low-noise (Aggre) failure
Self-contained background: noise models and the three distillers' objectives
Visualization of DATM distilled images across noise rates
Practical motivation: offline distillation as preprocessing in privacy-sensitive noisy settings
Poses how much to distill per noise rate and gives closed-form IPC/noise bounds
Follows original DATM/DANCE/RCIG evaluation protocols with standard ConvNets
